source_title: GA DPS/GDOT Rule Chapter 672-2 — Permits for Vehicles or Loads of Excess Weight or Dimension + O.C.G.A. §32-6-28 (fees), §32-6-24 (length)

superload_thresholds.note: Superload (Rule 672-2-.01(k)) = non-divisible load exceeding 16' width or 16' height, OR gross 150,001-180,000 lbs (axle-spacing data required over 150,000 lbs). Superload Plus (672-2-.01(l)) = over 180,000 lbs, requiring full axle weights/spacings for bridge/structural analysis; Mega Load = 300,000 lbs+ (engineering review, 30+ business days). Length is not a superload trigger (null) — over 125' overall only requires front + rear escorts.

width.note: over 12' up to 16' wide: front + rear escort on two-lane; rear escort only on 4-lane/limited-access (GA Rule 672-2-.06(3)(c))
over 16' wide: escorts determined case-by-case; police escort with blue lights (Georgia State Patrol) may be required

height.note: height 15'6" or greater: front escort with height sensor/pole (unless NJUNS overhead-clearance approval obtained)

length.note: 75'-100' overall: rear escort or rear amber light (672-2-.06)
over 125' overall: front and rear vehicle escorts

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip (standard) $30 flat, covers up to 16' W/H and 150,000 lbs (O.C.G.A. §32-6-28). Superload single-trip $125; Superload Plus and Mega Load $500. All fees are flat statutory amounts — Georgia has NO per-mile charge and NO overweight fee formula; overweight is priced by flat permit tier.
single_trip.note: Overweight evaluated per-application via bridge formula; axle weights/spacings required over 150,000 lbs, full axle data for bridge analysis over 180,000 lbs. No official flat routine per-axle table is published in Rule 672-2.

annual.note: Multi-trip $100; annual (standard) $150; Annual Plus / NHS $500; six-month tobacco/unginned-cotton $25; annual commercial-wrecker emergency-tow $500 (O.C.G.A. §32-6-28).

movement_restrictions: Standard travel window: 30 minutes after sunrise to 30 minutes before sunset (Eastern).
Continuous (24/7) movement allowed for loads 125,000 lbs or under at legal dimensions, except during fog, snow/ice, or Department-posted holidays.
Loads over 12' wide: no travel when visibility under 600 ft or winds over 25 mph.
Atlanta I-285 metro area: no travel 7-9 a.m. or 3-6 p.m. weekdays (pickup/delivery exception).
notes: Legal width 8'6", height 13'6", gross 80,000 lbs; semitrailer 53' (28' per trailer in twin combo), non-Interstate/non-NHS overall combo 100'.

GA OS/OW permits issued by GA DPS Motor Carrier Compliance Division. Fees and superload thresholds cross-confirmed by two official sources (O.C.G.A. §32-6-28 statute + DPS/MCCD portal); escort matrix, superload definitions and movement rules from official Rule 672-2 text, all fetched 2026-07-16. Exact rule amendment date not returned by the fetched extract (rules_as_of is a conservative estimate). State-level rules only.
